subject: SCIENCE
title: Heat and Electricity
objective: Identify safe everyday sources and uses through on-screen sorting only.
introduction: Heat is energy transfer related to temperature differences; electricity involves electric charge. Do not touch hot objects, outlets, damaged cords, or loose batteries.

vocabulary.definition: Energy that makes lights and machines work.
The power to do work, like light or heat.
